tools.name: compare_market
tools.description: Pricing comparison across market segments. Input is cohortKeys (at most ten) or a make, with an optional model.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two to four vehicle models. Input is composite make-model slugs such as honda-civic. The payload includes dimension deltas and the research record for each model. The link field on each model is url.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two to five listings, with specs, price context, and per-vehicle cite fields. Each vehicle row includes cite.vin and cite.url. cite.url is that listing's page on its own host.

tools.name: dealer_inventory
tools.description: Inventory for one dealer slug. Supports the same vehicle filters as the listings route. Listings with zero photos are omitted. The page size follows the tool limit, which is at most 100. Each vehicle row includes cite.vin and cite.url. cite.url is that listing's page on its own host.

tools.name: dealers_near
tools.description: Dealerships near a search area the shopper states: zip and radius, city and state, or county and state. tools.name: filter_vehicles
tools.description: Structured inventory lookup. Exact filters on the same live index as search_vehicles, with totals for those filters. tools.name: get_deal_score
tools.description: Deal score and market context for one listing: a 1 to 100 score with a rating, price versus the market average, days on lot, price history, and similar vehicles in the market.

tools.name: get_dealer
tools.description: Dealership record for one slug, or a display name that matches one rooftop. A shared display name returns candidate slugs. Fields include name, address, phone, website, Google rating, review count, hours, business status, inventory count, and profile links. URL fields on the record are website and u

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Market statistics for one vertical. inventory.totalVehicles is searchable priced listings on the live index. inventory.activeDealers is active dealers with at least one priced vehicle, the same population as dealers_near. marketData holds year-make-model cohort medians and sample sizes. tools.name: get_market_segment
tools.description: Pricing statistics for one market segment: average, median, minimum, and maximum price, percentiles, average mileage, average days on lot, and certified versus non-certified pricing when both exist.

tools.name: get_market_trends
tools.description: Price timeline for one market segment: median and average prices and days on lot.

tools.name: get_market_velocity
tools.description: Days-on-lot velocity by segment, fastest and slowest. The API paginates this list. Optional make and condition filters.

tools.name: get_safety_rating
tools.description: NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings for a year, make, and model. Includes overall and crash-test stars when published, rollover rating, and NHTSA-evaluated ADAS availability. A missing rating is reported as missing. The NHTSA link field is sourceUrl.

tools.name: get_similar_vehicles
tools.description: On-lot vehicles similar to one VIN, using the same make and model keyword comparison as the shop listing rail. The API caps the list. Each vehicle row includes cite.vin and cite.url. cite.url is that listing's page on its own host.

tools.name: get_suggested_rates
tools.description: National average suggested auto loan APRs for cars. This is not a credit offer. Other verticals return a not-available result until that vertical has a rate source. Optional filters are condition, termMonths from 36 to 84, and creditTier.

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: Listing details for one listingId or VIN. A VIN listed at more than one rooftop returns a vehicle_listings envelope of every listing, with no single price, seller, or url. listingId selects one store. The payload is Schema.org Vehicle data: specifications, images, price, availability, an NHTSA NCAP

tools.name: get_vehicle_history
tools.description: OpenDealer listing history for a VIN or listing id: price changes, days on lot, and status, including vehicles that left a dealer feed. Fields include chronological price history, days-on-market signals, badges, and active or no-longer-listed status when known. A sold vehicle has no deal score on th

tools.name: get_vehicle_rankings
tools.description: Data-driven vehicle rankings. With no category, the response lists ranking categories. A category slug returns that scored ranking. Scores use NHTSA ratings, EPA fuel economy, manufacturer pricing, and live availability. The link field is url.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Canonical filter tokens and counts from the live search index: make, bodyType, fuelType, transmission, drivetrain, and price and year ranges. Counts match filter_vehicles totals for the same make, condition, and location. Optional make, condition, certified, near, and radius scope the counts.

tools.name: list_market_segments
tools.description: One page of market segments with cohortKey, median price, and sample size. The API paginates this list at a maximum of 100.

tools.name: list_research_makes
tools.description: Research catalog of vehicle makes, with model counts and live inventory counts. The API returns one page, capped by limit.

tools.name: list_research_models
tools.description: Models for one make from the research catalog, with MSRP and body summaries.

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: Live shopper verticals: key, label, host, identifier kind, example classes, tool families, and whether the vertical is public. Reserved hosts are omitted. An absent vertical on other tools covers every public vertical.

tools.name: research_model
tools.description: Research record for one vehicle model: trims, MSRPs, engine and body specs, EPA fuel economy, NHTSA ratings, open recall count, and the live inventory count and price range. The link field is url.
